protocol.order: alternating mode order; same device, frontend results and input per mode
protocol.frontend: Actual Lab SIFT, KLT tracker/join and unchanged mergeTrackerPairs helper. No UI or video codec test. Frontend measured once and added to each mapper sample.
protocol.input: RGB plus known K; composited foreground case additionally supplies explicitly ground-truth region masks. No GT pose or depth enters reconstruction.
protocol.evaluation: GT camera stays in Node; one fixed seed gauge per complete map; no point geometry accuracy claim for unassociated RGB features.
protocol.limits: Small controlled render and composited 2D foreground/HUD; not actual gameplay, learned segmentation, native GPU, MVS or Radiance performance. Managed allocations include pool and exclude driver and host memory.
